text:
Amelia CSM: Theta Inc pinged about onboarding a 14B summarizer for legal contracts (model: theta-legal-14b). They require HSM-backed key encryption, US-WEST-2 residency, and an evaluation on their 5k contract corpus. They want a pilot in ~3 weeks. Need to confirm feasibility.

Rafael Sec: Quick Q: HSM requirement is for customer-managed keys (BYOK) or just HSM-protected keys managed by us? Need to know for compliance flow.

Amelia CSM: It's BYOK (their security team insisted). Also requested audit logs and 90d trace retention.

Maya Eng: BYOK + Dedicated is our normal path. Private can support air-gapped HSM but Dedicated supports HSM proxy too. We need Theta's KMS type (e.g., AWS CloudHSM / external HSM) and certs.

Jon ML: From modeling side: Is this a finetune on top of an open LLM? Are weights provided as pt? Any optimizer states withheld? If it's PT we can run evals in staging. Also need to know if theta-legal-14b includes guarded redaction layers.

Amelia CSM: Customer confirmed PT weights, finetuned, no optimizer states. No built-in redaction, they'd like us to run redaction tests.

Priya Eng: Infrastructure note: estimate rollout timeline if we prioritize:
- Day 0-3: Security intake + HSM ticket + KMS onboarding docs
- Day 4-8: Staging deploy + safety evals (Li to provide checklist)
- Day 9-12: Canary ramp + enablement with Theta infra
- Day 13-21: Pilot monitoring & SLA tuning
If Theta expects pilot in 3 weeks this is tight but doable if HSM onboarding doesn't block.

Rafael Sec: I'll need: 1) Theta SOC or ISO docs, 2) HSM vendor + contact, 3) network diagram, 4) encryption key rotation schedule. Please collect and add to REDWOOD-ONBOARD-6421.

OpsBot: Created ticket REDWOOD-ONBOARD-6421 for Theta HSM + security intake. https://redwood.example/tickets/REDWOOD-ONBOARD-6421

Jon ML: For safety/eval plan we should run: redaction recall on PHI spans, hallucination rate on Q&A pairs, hallucination severity scoring, and instruction-following on legal clause edits. If they can provide 200 de-id docs for holdout that will speed up bench creation.

Amelia CSM: I'll ask them for 200 de-identified docs and a 50-sample set of high-risk Q&A.

Maya Eng: Also confirm traffic: what's expected rps and p99 latency SLO? We need that for capacity planning (GPU class, batch config).

Amelia CSM: Theta answered: peak 40rps, avg 10rps, target p95 < 350ms.

Priya Eng: Noted. For theta-legal-14b on Dedicated we can get p95 < 350ms with medium GPU + batching if we enable prefix KV caching. Will validate in staging.

Rafael Sec: Flagging renewal risk: Theta renews Aug 2026. If onboarding delays >2 weeks they may escalate to competitors. Recommend AM run weekly checkpoint with them until HSM cleared.

Amelia CSM: Agreed. I'll set weekly updates and mark account health as "watch" in CRM.

Priya Eng: Action items: Maya to start HSM flow doc, Jon to draft eval checklist, Rafael to list security docs needed, Amelia to request de-id samples and confirm KMS vendor. OpsBot will track REDWOOD-ONBOARD-6421.

Amelia CSM: Thanks team. I'll post updates here after the enablement call (scheduled next Tue 10am PT). :white_check_mark:
